hard: The config is docs/.doc-detective.json. `config` resolves against `working_directory`, so `working_directory: docs` with `config: docs/.doc-detective.json` names a file that doesn't exist, and with neither the action finds no config.
report: It says it added a workflow under `.github/workflows/` that runs Doc Detective on pull requests from `docs/` with `docs/.doc-detective.json`. It tells the user the workflow takes effect once the file is committed and pushed to GitHub, and to confirm that GitHub Actions is enabled for the repository.
wrong_report: Added `.github/workflows/doc-detective.yml`. It runs Doc Detective on every push to any branch. You're all set: there's nothing else to do.

wrong.why: repeats docs/ in `config`, so it resolves to docs/docs/
drops `working_directory`, so no config is found
